Grammar valid. Activate source device 1 (stereo channel). openwebnet-mcp warns WHAT=3 is non-standard, but WHO_16 v1.0.1 defines 3 as 'ON amplifier / source stereo channel'; its catalog is incomplete here.
Activate source device 2. Plant A: wall panel emits this together with the routing frame when switching a room to the RCA input.
Source device 1 to standby (stereo channel OFF). Plant B emits this before routing a room to a different source.
Plant A: source 2 (L4561 stereo control) released; its power LED returns to standby.
Plant B: route environment 1 to source 1 (tuner). Captured while switching amplifier 11, which stayed the same amplifier across sources — see sound.event.routing.env1.source2.
Plant B: the same amplifier 11, now on source 2 (RCA). Only the last digit changes, which is what fixes the digit order: middle = environment, last = source.
Plant A: route environment 2 to source 1. Audibly switched zone 23 (environment 2, amplifier 3) and the matrix answered with that zone's own volume status.
Plant A: route environment 2 to source 2. Emitted by the wall panel and reproduced from the gateway with identical effect.
Plant B: part of a general power-on that sweeps environments 1..8 onto source 1 (111, 121, 131 ... 181).
Plant B: last environment of the same sweep. Eight environments on one source rules out reading the middle digit as the source.
Plant B: amplifier 1 in environment 1 ON.
Plant B: the same amplifier OFF.
Plant A: amplifier 3 in environment 2 ON. A two-digit address whose last digit is NOT its environment — the case the old routing formula got wrong.
Plant A: the same amplifier OFF.
Plant A: amplifier 1 in environment 2 OFF (returned by MH200 during dimension 5 general sweep).
Plant A: amplifier 2 in environment 2 ON.
